notes: Three small UI fixes (1.11.6): (1) Exams tab category cards - name, description and meta now stack vertically (.cat-body is a column flex container), so the category name no longer runs into its description (MazMaz mock exams); no text changed. (2) History & Analytics archive (and the Assignments list) no longer show the topic line when it is empty, equal to the title, or already contained in it - shared boxTopicShown() helper; no stored data changed. (3) Dashboard/Assignments Edit button was dead: partCard and the assignment card wired openEditBox onto the first .edit-btn in the card, which is the book-link button, so the real Edit button had no listener and the link button wrongly opened the edit modal too - both cards now use the scoped selector .part-actions .edit-btn (same scoping applied to the Remaining list, which had only one .edit-btn). No other data, API, sync, layout or programme-logic changes.
